title: The Eight Places of the Living Fire
description: Divine love (the Living Fire) traced through eight discrete stations: from its hidden seat in the Land of Light below, through the Father's reflection, the First Man's body as weapon, the wall outside, the ship of the day (sun), the luminary of the night (moon), the Third Ambassador's Call-and-Hearing, the regenerate land through the first woman, and finally the visible cosmic signs drawn from the two ships. The same divine love runs as a single thread through every level.
